newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares finish off in form, more gains ahead.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares finish off in form, more gains ahead.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Monday, rounding off the day in style after a negative start with dealers foreseeing more gains ahead.

"Contrary to expectations, we got off to a negative start due to the weaker dollar and pound sterling. But we later recovered to more than make up for early losses. We are well set up for more gains tomorrow in a busier market, but it all depends on the Dow," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.46 point higher at 156.60 while the KFX March future rose 0.55 point to 158.05 with 140 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Novo Nordisk finished four crowns lower at 675, two days ahead of its 1996 full year result.

Among Monday's best performers were NKT, which rose 20 crowns to 440 on a purchase recommendation and FLS which put on 15 crowns to end the day at 860 on the sale of its FLS Data unit to United States' EDS.
Banks progressed, notably Unidanmark and Den Danske which both closed seven up at 365 and 605 respectively.
Overall turnover for the day was only 875 million crowns. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
